segments.en: I'm Jennifer Zabasagia in Johannesburg. More than 30 years after the last Formula One Grand Prix in Africa, the competition is returning to the continent.
segments.zh: 我是詹妮弗·扎巴萨吉亚，在约翰内斯堡报道。非洲上一场F1大奖赛三十多年后，赛事重返非洲大陆。

segments.en: Rwanda has been chosen to host beating competition from countries including South Africa and Morocco.
segments.zh: 卢旺达击败南非和摩洛哥等国，被选为主办地。

segments.en: For many years, we have spoken about our desire to return, but always said we would return in the right way, with the right vision and the right partners.
segments.zh: 多年来，我们一直谈论重返的愿望，但始终表示将以正确方式、正确愿景和正确伙伴回归。
